resources.name: Periodic DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, VASP)

access.notes: Any open-source periodic DFT code with PBE functional is acceptable. VASP is also acceptable if the solver has a license.
Standard PBE pseudopotentials (or PAW datasets) for C, N, H, Cl, Au. Distributed with DFT codes or from pseudopotential repositories.
